title: Mixed Event — Let's Enjoy Together! SpoJoy Park — Episode1 Maybe I Should Exercise

meta.Event Outline: Kanade's fatigue has been catching up to her as of late. Worried that it might affect her compositions, she decides to put effort into building her stamina alongside Ena. They hear that a new sports facility called SpoJoy Park just opened near the station...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I need to log off soon...
I should be able to upload my lyrics by tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yuki really hasn't been able to stay on for very long lately, huh? Until just recently, she'd sometimes work pretty late into the night.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
To be fair, she's busy studying for her entrance exams on top of everything that happened the other day with her practice exam.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<True...
Now that you mention it, writing songs while studying as much as she does sounds way too hard.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I know, right?!
If I were in her shoes, my brain would probably stop working because there's way too much to juggle.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I'm also really glad that she wants to keep joining us to work despite all the studying she has to do...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, we should do our best to work just as hard!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<K, is something wrong?
You seem really tired today.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Are you having some trouble writing that song?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <When I went to go visit my dad in the hospital today...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I brought more spare clothes than usual today, and it's taking just that much more of a toll on me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Uh oh... My head's starting to spin a bit...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I...
I should find somewhere to rest...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry about asking you out of the blue like this, but I'm only here to help! Honest!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... You seem really fatigued and I was worried that maybe you weren't feeling well...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, if there's anything I can do for you, please feel free to... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! Kanade, it's really you!
How long's it been?! New Year's?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You went with your group for a shrine visit, remember? I was helping out as a shrine maiden at that time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I also need to thank you for what you said during the Fan Festival... It made me so happy!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! You said that I was really bright...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I remember...
The one singing that time was...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, it was me! Minori Hanasato!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hanasato...
Right, it's been a while.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, it has! And I'm really happy to see you again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
I'm making you talk so much even though you're probably not feeling well!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm just going over to visit my dad at the hospital, so I should be fine after I rest for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In that case, I can carry your stuff for you on your way over!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But it's so heavy...
I can't make you carry...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was just jogging to get ready for our next show, so it's totally fine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Carrying something heavy will be good training for me too! Please, let me help!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I sort of feel bad about having her help me like this, but I'm not sure I'll make it to the hospital if I don't...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, I really appreciate the help.
And I'm sorry for making you do this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, it's okay!
I'm really glad that I can help!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, I'll take those and...
Alright, all set!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Which way to the hospital?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Phew... We made it.
Oh, do you need me to carry these inside?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, the nurses can take care of things from here. Thank you very much. I really don't know what to say...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I can't believe how easy it was for you to carry something so heavy, Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? It didn't feel that heavy to me...
Maybe all the training I've been doing for our show's finally starting to pay off!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna keep doing my best and keep trying more and more and more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, if you'll excuse me!
See you later, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Thank goodness Hanasato was there to lend me a hand. There's no way I would've been able to carry everything over on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I caused someone else a lot of trouble, so maybe I should start working out a little to build my stamina...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, so that's what was bothering you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But you really do have less stamina than most people, K. Wait, didn't you say just the other day that your body felt really heavy?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, that feeling usually went away after I slept, but my shoulders have been feeling so heavy this time around...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Isn't that because you don't get enough exercise? I mean, your shoulders can get stiff just from sitting at a desk all day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! You might be able to manage for now, but what if it starts keeping you from working on songs?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, that'd be bad...
What do you think I should do...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, getting yourself to exercise on a regular basis is probably the best solution. Why not take this opportunity to start going outside for walks or jogs?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That's right.
Once you get in the habit of moving your body around, your stamina should naturally improve.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And if jogging like Minori turns out to be too much, you can always just go out for walks instead!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That still sounds like a lot for K. On top of everything, it's been really hot out lately.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, you don't have to push yourself that hard, and you have tons of other options in terms of getting in a good workout.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Maybe I should give it a try...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I have to avoid not being able to work on music at all costs and I don't want to be a bother to anyone else.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Right...
Okay, that's good enough for me. What do you say, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I'm still a bit startled, but alright...
You have my support. Good luck, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thank you, Enanan.
I don't know how things are going to go, but I'll give it a try...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Great! But don't push yourself too hard, okay? It's totally okay to take breaks and let us know if you need anything!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<You don't have to worry so...
No, I can't guarantee that I'll be okay...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know! What if Enanan joined you, K?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Didn't you say that you might've put on some extra weight recently? You could probably shed some of that off if you exercise together, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What? It's just a bit of bloating!
If that's how it's gonna be, then you should exercise with us, Amia!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I have shifts scheduled on my days off, and I already exercise plenty as it is.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Grr...!
You think you're so great because you exercise regularly...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But it might actually be worth a try. Also, I kinda don't feel great about having K exercise all by herself...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And this doesn't count as me going on a diet...!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thank you, Enanan...
I really appreciate it. I honestly wasn't sure how I'd fare on my own.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I mean, it's for my own benefit too.
Anyway, let's meet at the park this weekend.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And thank you for suggesting this, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No problem!
I hope you two break a good sweat!>

<Hehe...
I came to see how they were doing since I was getting a bit bored...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But I have a feeling this is going to be very fun.>
